Type: six-drawer wide dresser
Use: storing clothes; bedroom
Style: farmhouse, rustic, traditional
Materials: oak wood with visible grain, matte finish, antiqued metal bar pulls
Colors: warm natural honey wood, dark bronze
Shape: long low case, two columns of three drawers, framed side panels, overhanging top, short square post legs, solid and substantial
Feel: warm, sturdy, homey
Goes with: cream walls, linen bedding, black or bronze accents; farmhouse or rustic bedrooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Parson 6-Drawer Wood Bedroom Dresser, 60"W, Natural
product.description: This is modern farmhouse at its best. Oak veneer gives a distinctive grain to the body and drawers of this dresser, and metal pulls complete the simple design. The natural beauty of this piece provides a relaxing tone to your bedroom. 60"W x 19"D x 35"H Solid hardwood with hand-selected oak veneer This rustic dresser has the look of natural reclaimed wood with distressed finish. Self-closing drawers are suspended on concealed ball-bearing extension glides. No assembly needed. Wipe with soft dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
